text:
maria: Heads-up — staging->VPC sequential transport for private-installer 1.12.0 is scheduled in ~20m. Need final signoff on signer and transport window. Who's watching signer TTL?

 dave: I can watch signer. Which signer are we using? ops-signer-v2?

 jen: Yes ops-signer-v2 with KMS wrap. Last rotation was 2026-02-15, TTL set to 72h.

 sam: deploybot just published artifacts to the staging mirror set. Sample artifact names: private-installer-1.12.0.tar.gz, submanifest-epoch-20260319.json. sha256 samples in the publish log.

 deploybot: Release private/1.12.0 canary -> staging started at 2026-03-21T09:40Z. Canary 3/10 hosts. CI: https://ci/release/12345 (logs).

 liam: FYI one of the staging mirrors flagged a cosign mismatch during dryrun. Error shows: "cosign: signature expired" for submanifest epoch-20260319.

 maria: Hmm — that's signer TTL drift. Options: (1) pause transport and regenerate signatures, (2) pin to previous epoch and continue, (3) force-pass canary with manual watch. Thoughts?

 dave: Pinning is lower blast radius. Previous epoch 20260317 has valid signatures until 2026-03-24.

 jen: Pin requires a small deploybot action. Command to run:

 ```
 deploybot pin-manifest --channel staging --manifest epoch-20260317 --reason "signer drift"
 ```

 sam: If we pin, ensure on-prem installer image tag/hash matches that epoch. Example: redwood/private-installer:1.12.0-epoch20260317 sha256:deadbeef...

 maria: Can someone run a quick checksum on the failing mirror? @dave?

 dave: Running check now:

 ```
 ssh mirror-staging-3
 sha256sum /opt/installer/private-installer-1.12.0.tar.gz
 # got: deadbeef... matches epoch20260317
 ```

 dave: Confirmed artifact hashes match epoch-20260317. The cosign failure looks like the signature header timestamp (expired), not the binary.

 liam: If we pin we should alert support/customer-success — private VPC customers might see signer mismatch in their preflight checks.

 maria: @support notified. Also will update release notes to mention we pinned to epoch-20260317 due to signer TTL drift and that we will re-sign.

 deploybot: manifest pinned to epoch-20260317 by dave at 2993210045. Canary progressed 3/10 -> 6/10.

 jen: Plan: continue canary for 30m, if no regressions we proceed full transport. In parallel: regenerate signatures, add TTL monitoring for signer, and audit packaging pipeline.

 sam: Opened PR to bump signer TTL check in packaging pipeline: https://github.com/redwood/release/pull/789 — adds explicit pre-publish TTL gate.

 maria: Post-deploy tasks (tracked): 1) re-sign artifacts and republish signed manifest, 2) schedule airgap re-scan to validate signed submanifests, 3) rotate signer with customer notice. Any objections?

 liam: No objections. :thumbsup:

 dave: Added an auto-rollback gate: if any mirror reports cosign mismatch again during full transport, deploybot will rollback to 1.11.9 and open an incident.

 maria: Great. I'll update release notes and spawn a follow-up thread for signer rotation and TTL alerting. Thanks everyone. :rotating_light:
